mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.0% consistently compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days in any economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during late-cycle expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1.0% from the prior month indicate broad-based demand contraction, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline by > 1.0% from the prior month, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing slowdowns (INDPRO < 100) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%), stagflationary pressures produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100 and CPIAUCSL > 5.0%, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points in one month signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5pp in 1 month, or the Rank IC over 2 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS increasing > 0.5% monthly) consistently supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days in any economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth is above 0.5% monthly, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In early economic expansion (GDPC1 growth > 1.5% annualized), strong consumer spending (RSAFS growth > 1.0% monthly) drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS growth > 1.0% monthly and GDPC1 growth > 1.5% annualized, or the Rank IC for the signal in this regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO < 100) signals economic weakening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days during a manufacturing slowdown regime.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
